description: Grey-blue plates, white rime in every seam, cold to hold. All a Frostling's melt leaves; its hits leave a target wading.
lore: The only cold hard piece. Every other kind sits at blood heat within a breath of being picked up; this one stays cold for as long as anyone has troubled to hold it, and the sorters use that as the test — blue junk warms in the hand while you are still asking after it, a real one never does.

The price is not about the stone; it is about the walk. The high snow lies a long way above the last fire anybody still tends, and a collector broken up there — usually by the very [[monsters/ice_poring|Frostling]] they were working — comes back together beside the nearest fire still kept, which is most often [[characters/6bb1eb5a|Solveig's]] on the meadow, a full day's climb below the morning's collecting, still lying in the drift where it fell.

Solveig has learned the look of it: somebody assembling out of the fire-warmth at noon with snow still in their idea of themselves. She puts the kettle on and does not ask. By evening, as a rule, they are talking about going back up. Not many go up twice in a season. She has never once asked the ones who do.
